root_cause: The daily blog artifact was generated before all technical SEO, performance, machine metadata and canonical writeback requirements had been completed in the same delivery lineage.
prevention_rule: A daily blog is not complete at generation. The same candidate must include technical SEO 100, Lighthouse thresholds, sitemap/index/RSS registration, exact PR metadata, Brain learning, ledger and human documentation, followed by protected merge, Netlify production deploy and public canonical readback.

evidence.initial_gate_failures: Missing metadata plus technical SEO contract failures and Lighthouse performance below threshold.
evidence.repair: Machine metadata restored, SEO contract brought to 100 and third-party render blockers removed from the article critical path.
evidence.truth_rule: Generated or previewed is not published; public production readback is required.
